legal_basis: Section 26A, Drugs and Cosmetics Act 1940 (prohibitions) and CDSCO directives on unapproved FDCs
note: Bans are notified by composition (generic names), never by brand name. Some entries carry court stays, are under examination, or were revoked; the status field records this exactly as published. Absence from this list does not mean a medicine is approved or safe.
